usedFor: Perfex CRM holds support tickets, and Slack alerts your team through “Send Message” when one opens.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Perfex CRM, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new ticket posts to Slack, so support sees it without watching the CRM.

watchOut: “New Ticket” in Perfex CRM is polling, and an automation's Slack post waits for your approval today.
